Our History

Built on culture & innovation

CEO

Chris Caldwell

Concentrix China

Alan Cao

Concentrix China Digital Business
CM Digital Business

Travis Wu

Since its founding, Concentrix has built its business on a solid foundation of culture and values. In the early stages of development, the successful acquisitions of IBM Customer Care and Convergys were made. In 2020, Concentrix completed a spin-off from its former parent company to become a NASDAQ-listed company; publicly traded since then, the company has continued to grow organically including the acquisitions of PKGlobal, ServiceSource (NASDAQ: SREV), and the completion of a merger with France Webhelp in 2023, which has propelled Concentrix to become a great innovative digital technology services company that will make its Fortune 500 debut in 2024.
